email.title: Confirm your email
email.description: We need a working email address so we can reach you even if LINE is unavailable. We don't use the email registered with LINE.
email.existingAccountNote: Already have an account with this email? Confirming it here connects your LINE sign-in to that account.

line.title: Get updates on LINE
line.description: Link LINE and add the AIS Alumni Committee Official Account to get news and chat mentions there.
line.emailFallback: You can change this anytime in Settings. If you skip, we'll email you instead.

status.contact: If you think this is a mistake, please contact the AIS Alumni Committee.
status.lineBody: Once approved, get news and chat mentions on LINE. We'll email you the result of your application.

PENDING_REVIEW.title: Thanks — we're checking your application
PENDING_REVIEW.body: The AIS Alumni Committee is reviewing your details. This usually takes a few days. We'll let you know as soon as it's done.

REJECTED.title: We couldn't verify your account
REJECTED.body: Unfortunately the committee couldn't confirm your connection to AIS, so your account was not activated.

DEACTIVATED.title: Your account is deactivated
DEACTIVATED.body: This account is currently deactivated, so you can't use the member site.

parentWaiting.title: Waiting for your child's approval
parentWaiting.body: Your parent account opens as soon as one of your children is approved and your relationship is confirmed.

state.needsConfirm: Waiting for your child to confirm
